title: I want to revenge
simplified_paragraphs: 一个人对他朋友说：“这家公司对我不好！我要离开，我要报复！”
他朋友说：“我同意。不过，你现在离开，不是很好，因为公司不会失去什么。”
这个人问：“那我要怎么做？”
朋友说：“我觉得你要好好工作，先找到很多客户，再离开公司，让公司失去这些客户。”
这个人觉得朋友说得很对，就好好工作。一年后，他有了很多客户。
再见面时，朋友对他说：“现在是报复的好时机，你快离开公司！”
这个人笑着说：“经理告诉我，准备让我做经理助理，我现在不想离开公司了。”
traditional_paragraphs: 一個人對他朋友說：“這家公司對我不好！我要離開，我要報復！”
他朋友說：“我同意。不過，你現在離開，不是很好，因為公司不會失去什麼。”
這個人問：“那我要怎麼做？”
朋友說：“我覺得你要好好工作，先找到很多客戶，再離開公司，讓公司失去這些客戶。”
這個人覺得朋友說得很對，就好好工作。一年後，他有了很多客戶。
再見面時，朋友對他說：“現在是報復的好時機，你快離開公司！”
這個人笑著說：“經理告訴我，準備讓我做經理助理，我現在不想離開公司了。”
pinyin_paragraphs: yī gè rén duì tā péng you shuō：“ zhè jiā gōng sī duì wǒ bù hǎo！ wǒ yào lí kāi， wǒ yào bào fù！”
tā péng you shuō：“ wǒ tóng yì。 bù guò， nǐ xiàn zài lí kāi， bù shì hěn hǎo， yīn wèi gōng sī bù huì shī qù shén me。”
zhè gè rén wèn：“ nà wǒ yào zěn me zuò？”
péng you shuō：“ wǒ jué de nǐ yào hǎo hǎo gōng zuò， xiān zhǎo dào hěn duō kè hù， zài lí kāi gōng sī， ràng gōng sī shī qù zhè xiē kè hù。”
zhè gè rén jué de péng you shuō de hěn duì， jiù hǎo hǎo gōng zuò。 yī nián hòu， tā yǒu le hěn duō kè hù。
zài jiàn miàn shí， péng you duì tā shuō：“ xiàn zài shì bào fù de hǎo shí jī， nǐ kuài lí kāi gōng sī！”
zhè gè rén xiào zhe shuō：“ jīng lǐ gào su wǒ， zhǔn bèi ràng wǒ zuò jīng lǐ zhù lǐ， wǒ xiàn zài bù xiǎng lí kāi gōng sī le。”
english_paragraphs: A man said to his friend, “This company treats me badly! I’m going to quit. I want to get back at them!”
His friend said, “I agree. But quitting now isn’t a good idea, because the company won’t lose anything.”
The man asked, “Then what should I do?”
His friend said, “I think you should work hard and build up a lot of clients first. Then quit and take those clients with you.”
The man thought his friend was right, so he worked hard. A year later, he had a lot of clients.
The next time they met, his friend said, “Now’s the perfect time to get back at the company. Quit right away!”
The man smiled and said, “The manager told me he’s planning to make me his assistant. I don’t want to quit anymore.”
english_full:
A man said to his friend, “This company treats me badly! I’m going to quit. I want to get back at them!”

His friend said, “I agree. But quitting now isn’t a good idea, because the company won’t lose anything.”

The man asked, “Then what should I do?”

His friend said, “I think you should work hard and build up a lot of clients first. Then quit and take those clients with you.”

The man thought his friend was right, so he worked hard. A year later, he had a lot of clients.

The next time they met, his friend said, “Now’s the perfect time to get back at the company. Quit right away!”

The man smiled and said, “The manager told me he’s planning to make me his assistant. I don’t want to quit anymore.”
